ios.desc:
Turn your wall into a giant speaker or transform a road into a rolling wave of notes with Beatsy, a groundbreaking augmented reality music visualizer. Distort the world around you to your music or voice!

Highlights:

• Distort the world around you using microphone input or music from your library.

• Ten unique and customizable visualizers.

• Scale visualizers up to epic sizes.

• On devices with a LiDAR sensor, try the immersive visualizers which let you distort the world in three dimensions.

• Capture and share photos and videos of the effects in action.

So get Beatsy and start experiencing sound in a whole new way!
